inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The manuscript names the closest relevant method families, distinguishes inherited principles from project-specific elements, and keeps novelty unassessed wherever the frozen evidence cannot support it.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: The comparison names the nearest method families, identifies the manuscript's bounded contribution, and retains an explicit no-exhaustive-priority boundary.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Manuscript-side comparison text names the closest relevant canonical-form, computational-group-theory, proof-carrying-data, and ledger-verification method families; distinguishes inherited principles from project-specific elements; identifies only a bounded project contribution; and explicitly leaves novelty or priority unassessed where the frozen evidence cannot support it, including a no-exhaustive-priority boundary.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix supplies a closest-work comparison or a bounded contribution distinction but leaves at least one inherited component unmet—for example, a relevant method family is unnamed, inherited and project-specific elements remain conflated, or the unsupported-novelty/no-exhaustive-priority boundary is absent.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, closest-work positioning becomes less specific, inherited and project-specific elements become more conflated, or novelty/priority language becomes stronger where the frozen evidence does not support it.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Introduction and Frozen Literature and Theoretical Boundary, especially roadmap-proposed blocks B0016 (replace_block) and B0033 (insert_after); equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every artifact described as recoverable has a stable locator plus an exact digest and access status, or the corresponding prose no longer claims reader retrieval.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Every material described as recoverable has a stable locator, exact digest, schema/version, and access state, or its retrieval claim is removed.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every material the manuscript describes as reader-recoverable, manuscript-side availability information gives a stable locator, exact digest, schema or version, and access state; alternatively, each corresponding retrieval claim is removed so that no material is described as recoverable without those fields.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix supplies locator, digest, schema/version, or access information for only some claimed materials, leaves one or more required fields missing, or narrows only some unsupported retrieval claims.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, additional materials are described as recoverable without the required locator/digest/schema-or-version/access fields, or existing recoverability information or claim narrowing is lost.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Reproducibility and Prospective Interface and Data and materials availability, especially roadmap-proposed blocks B0079 (replace_block or insert_after) and B0105 (replace_block); equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The scholarly-method narrative no longer uses the prior panel outcome as evidence for the architecture, and any retained development history is explicitly labeled as provenance.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: No prior decision or finding count is presented as evidence for the certificate architecture.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The scholarly-method narrative contains no prior panel decision or finding count used as evidence for the certificate architecture, and any retained development or review history is explicitly labeled and separated as provenance rather than evidentiary support.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix relabels or relocates some prior-review material but leaves a prior decision, finding count, or other retained development history functioning as architectural evidence or not explicitly identified as provenance.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, prior decision codes, finding counts, or review history gain a stronger evidentiary role in the scholarly-method narrative or their provenance labeling becomes less explicit.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Executed Methodology and end matter, especially roadmap-proposed blocks B0041 (replace_block) and B0099 (insert_after); equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The type signatures distinguish resolved owner bytes from unresolved dispositions, every totality statement uses the matching type, and the biconditional and G/I/C closure rule share an explicit domain and stop condition.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Owner bytes, unresolved dispositions, biconditional scope, and the zero-unresolved G/I/C gate have noncontradictory types and quantifiers.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Manuscript-side type signatures separately define the resolved-domain owner-byte map and the total disposition process; every totality statement quantifies over the matching type; both directions of the owner-byte biconditional have an explicit, consistent resolved domain; and complete G/I/C materialization is governed by the same domain plus an explicit zero-unresolved stop condition, with no contradictory types or quantifiers.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix separates some types or quantifiers but leaves at least one inconsistency among owner bytes, unresolved dispositions, biconditional domain, totality statements, or the zero-unresolved G/I/C closure gate.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, resolved owner bytes and unresolved dispositions are more strongly conflated, a totality statement is broadened to an incompatible type, or the biconditional and G/I/C stop condition become less domain-consistent.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Each claimed equivalence property is paired with an audit surface that can observe it, and the unordered distinct-pair table is not credited with self-pair, direction-reversal, or triple evidence it does not contain.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Each relation property is paired with an audit surface that can observe it, and no omitted row type is credited as evidence.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every claimed relation or equivalence property, the manuscript explicitly identifies an audit surface capable of observing that property; it does not credit the unordered distinct-pair table with self-pair, direction-reversal, triple, or any other omitted-row evidence.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix maps some relation properties to observable audit surfaces or narrows some table claims, but at least one claimed property remains paired with an incapable surface or one omitted row type is still credited as evidence.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, the unordered distinct-pair table is credited with additional unobservable relation properties or the mapping from a claimed property to a capable audit surface becomes less explicit.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: The 9,453-row table as a derived adversarial audit, especially roadmap-proposed blocks B0062, B0064, and B0065 (replace_block); equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The named contract artifacts are reader-resolvable and mutually version-bound, or the manuscript explicitly limits the present contribution to a non-executable specification and removes stronger replay implications.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Artifact availability and version bindings support every executable/replay statement, or those statements are narrowed to the evidenced specification boundary.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript takes one complete criterion-permitted branch: either every named certificate/verifier contract artifact needed by its executable or replay statements is reader-resolvable and mutually version-bound, or the contribution is explicitly limited to a non-executable specification and every stronger executable or replay implication is narrowed to that evidenced boundary.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix exposes or version-binds only some named contract artifacts, or narrows only some executable/replay statements, leaving neither criterion-permitted branch complete.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, executable or replay implications become stronger without corresponding reader-resolvable, mutually version-bound artifacts, or the non-executable specification boundary becomes less explicit.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The supplement records exact queries and every screening disposition, while each method component has an exact source locator, applicable hypotheses, and an explicit transfer boundary; unavailable checks remain labeled unresolved.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Queries, screening outcomes, theorem passages, hypotheses, representation constraints, and prohibited transfers are recorded, with unresolved checks visibly retained.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A manuscript-linked supplement records the exact search queries and every screening disposition, and each method component is linked to an exact theorem or source passage with its applicable hypotheses, representation constraints, and prohibited transfer boundary; any unavailable check remains visibly labeled unresolved.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix records only some queries or screening dispositions, or supplies source passages for only some method components, or omits an applicable hypothesis, representation constraint, prohibited transfer, or unresolved-check label.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, literature-method traceability loses query, screening, passage, hypothesis, representation, transfer-boundary, or unresolved-status information, or aggregate closure is asserted more strongly without that information.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The inverse rule cites an applicable exact lemma or specifies a self-reciprocal disposition, and the selected branch is logically consistent with both directions of the owner-byte biconditional.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: The inverse rule and both biconditional directions remain consistent for every declared branch.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every declared inverse branch, the manuscript either cites an applicable exact lemma excluding subgroup self-reciprocity or specifies a typed self-reciprocal disposition, and the resulting inverse rule is logically consistent with both directions of the owner-byte biconditional.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix gives a lemma, branch, or inverse-policy clarification but does not establish applicability or leaves at least one declared branch inconsistent with one direction of the biconditional.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, inverse separation becomes more categorical without an applicable lemma or typed self-reciprocal branch, or any declared branch becomes less consistent with the biconditional.

inherited_criterion.letter_text: The I-to-G/C direction and G/C-to-I information loss are directly checkable from the schema surface.

operationalization.fully_addressed: One consolidated table in the manuscript directly exposes G/I/C keys, cardinalities, materialization gates, permitted I-to-G/C projections, and prohibited G/C-to-I reconstruction so that both the forward direction and reverse information loss are checkable without inferring constraints from prose.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix provides a non-table or distributed schema surface instead of one consolidated table, or provides one consolidated table but leaves at least one required key/cardinality, materialization gate, I-to-G/C projection, or prohibited G/C-to-I reconstruction implicit or not directly checkable.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, the G/I/C presentation moves farther from one consolidated table by becoming more dispersed or ambiguous, or the table requirement, permitted projection direction, reverse information loss, or a materialization gate becomes less explicit or checkable.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The example is labeled hypothetical, contains no owner result, identifies common versus route-specific evidence, and shows the exact verifier checks and fail-closed boundary for incompatible semantics.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: The trace contains no owner result, distinguishes route-private from common fields, and shows the exact fail-closed boundary.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A manuscript-side heterogeneous-producer trace is explicitly labeled hypothetical, contains no owner result, distinguishes route-private evidence or fields from common owner-semantic fields, and identifies the exact verifier checks and fail-closed boundary for incompatible semantics.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix supplies a hypothetical cross-producer trace but leaves its non-result status, route-private/common distinction, exact verifier checks, or fail-closed boundary unspecified.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, a cross-producer example is framed more like an owner result, route-private and common fields become more conflated, or verifier and fail-closed boundaries become less explicit.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every semantic-audit claim names evidence generated independently of canonical-byte equality, while any byte-derived check is explicitly limited to the defects it can observe.
inherited_criterion.letter_text: Every semantic check names independent evidence, and every byte-derived check is limited to serialization, binding, inverse-label, traversal-metadata, or bookkeeping consistency.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every manuscript claim of a semantic audit names evidence generated independently of canonical-byte equality; alternatively, any claim lacking such evidence is narrowed out. Every check derived from canonical bytes is explicitly limited to serialization, binding, inverse-label, traversal-metadata, or bookkeeping consistency and is not credited with detecting semantic false merges or splits.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine but incomplete fix binds independent evidence for only some semantic checks or narrows only some unsupported semantic claims, or leaves at least one byte-derived check credited beyond the listed observable defect classes.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression is present if, relative to the original manuscript, byte-derived checks receive stronger semantic force without independent evidence, or the limits on serialization, binding, inverse-label, traversal-metadata, and bookkeeping checks become less explicit.
